descripcion:
QF ERP es la app interna de QF Producciones para manejar la empresa desde el iPhone.

Con tu usuario de la empresa puedes:
• Ver y crear eventos, producciones y transmisiones.
• Hacer cotizaciones y propuestas, con su PDF.
• Llevar la facturación y la cobranza: facturas, cobros y cartera.
• Registrar gastos de los eventos y gastos generales.
• Manejar el personal técnico, sus asignaciones y liquidaciones.
• Usar Flota: gasolina, gastos, servicios, viajes y costo por km de los vehículos.
• Ver el panel financiero y los informes.

HECHA PARA EL IPHONE
• Atajos en el ícono (mantén presionado): Eventos, Facturación y Flota.
• Los PDF y Excel se abren y se comparten con la hoja de Compartir o se guardan en Archivos.
• Foto del recibo con la cámara y ubicación para la gasolinera, solo cuando tú lo pides.
• Pantalla propia sin conexión: cuando vuelve la señal, la página se carga sola.
• Jala hacia abajo para actualizar.

Es una herramienta de trabajo: solo pueden entrar las personas a las que la empresa les creó un usuario.

Hecho en Ecuador por QF Producciones y Tukán Software.
texto_promocional: Eventos, cotizaciones, facturación, gastos, personal y flota de QF Producciones en tu iPhone, al instante.
notas_revisor:
1. Screen recording (physical iPhone, latest iOS): {video}

2. Purpose and audience: QF ERP is the internal management app of QF Producciones, an event and live-broadcast production company in Ecuador (same group as Tukán Software). It is for the company's own staff and for the clients and collaborators it creates users for: they see and create events and productions, quotes and proposals (with PDF), invoicing and collections, event expenses, technical staff assignments and settlements, fleet control, and the financial panel and reports. Problem it solves: replaces spreadsheets and chats in running events, quotes and costs.

3. How to use it: sign in with the demo account in the App Review Information section (a user of a sample company with invented data). After login, the ☰ menu (the same as the web ERP) includes Eventos (open an event for its details, call sheet and rundown), Calendario, Cotizaciones and Contratos, Facturación and Facturación Electrónica (invoices, payments and receivables), Finanzas & Reportes and Reporte Mensual (P&L), Calculadora de Costos, Reuniones y Visitas, Viajes, Hoteles y Notas, Personal and its payments, Flota (fuel, expenses, services, trips, cost per km) and Ajustes. What each user sees depends on their role (administrator, accounting, coordinator, employee, driver); drivers go straight to Flota. Accounts are created by QF Producciones for its staff and collaborators; there is no self sign-up in the iOS app, and account deletion is handled on request (info@tukansoftware.com). On iPhone there are no prices, plans or payments for our software: it is an internal tool, not sold through the app. The invoices and payments shown are the company's own business records, not digital content.

4. External services: the company's own server (erp.tupassec.com); WhatsApp messages (optional, for call sheets and reminders); Telegram notifications (optional); email (SMTP); Cloudflare (hosting/CDN); Google Calendar sync (optional, for administrators); Ecuador's electronic invoicing system (SRI) for the company's own invoices; OpenStreetMap to suggest nearby gas stations in Flota (only when the user asks). Camera: photos of receipts, equipment and event documents when the user attaches them. Location: only when the user taps the GPS button (event place, gas station). No ads, no third-party analytics.

5. Regional differences: none. The app works the same in every region (Spanish).

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not regulated. Access is only for people the company created a user for. Privacy policy: https://erp.tupassec.com/privacidad.php.
